title: Compare digit alphabets
description: You can see which digit characters two patterns accept.

steps.description: You import re for regular-expression matching.
The loop supplies ASCII 42 and Devanagari four, two.

steps.question: Will both patterns accept the Devanagari string?
steps.answer: Only the backslash-d pattern accepts it. [0-9] selects ASCII digits.

steps.description: fullmatch tests the whole string. The output agrees for ASCII digits and differs for Devanagari digits.
